Name: ZOOM_BLUR_ST
Description: Defines how zooming in blurs the screen peripheral.

Fields.Name: Fixed Center
Fields.Description: If ON, the blur is centred on the middle of the screen instead of the character position.

Fields.Name: Blur Offset
Fields.Description: Offset of the zoom blur displacement.

Fields.Name: Centre Thinning
Fields.Description: How much the blur is thinned near the centre. -1: no blur near the centre. 1: the centre is blurred as well.
